dedupe_keys.name: e redes open data portal portuguese distribution substations hosting capacity hourly substation load and power quality

description: E-REDES, the main electricity distribution operator in mainland Portugal, publishes 70 datasets on an Opendatasoft portal, read through its catalogue API on 2026-09-26. Secondary substations (72,434 medium to low voltage transformer stations) come with location, installed power, usage band over the last 12 months, construction type, contracted power, customer and producer counts. For HV/MV substations the portal gives quarterly reception (hosting) capacity for generation with forecasts, winter and summer natural load and guaranteed power, and network characteristics including transformation ratios, installed power, maximum and minimum short-circuit powers and neutral regime. Hourly load diagrams of substations since the 2025 release are split into five regional datasets, updated monthly and together holding about 14 million rows, and power quality datasets report voltage dips, overvoltages and continuous phenomena at monitored busbars against NP EN 50160. Data are free under CC BY 4.0, with E-REDES noting that values are approximations taken from its systems. Caveats: power quality covers selected monitoring points only. Simulation uses are network flow and hosting capacity studies, capacity planning and resilience analysis of the Portuguese distribution grid. Related records: data-sp-electricity-north-west-open-data-portal is a comparable British portal.
